[[File:Bronze battleaxe detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''bronze battleaxe''' is a [[battleaxe]] made of [[bronze]]. The weakest battleaxe in the game, it requires 1 [[Attack]] to wield. Players can make a bronze battleaxe with the [[Smithing]] skill at level 10 using 3 [[bronze bar]]s, giving 37.5 experience. It is a [[slashing]] weapon, which makes it good for monsters with a slash weakness. Players can purchase this battleaxe from [[Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar]] in [[Port Sarim]].
